_about: Hand-written annotations merged into game_data/roles.json by build.ps1. The game files give the role ids and complexity; names, positions and summaries are written here. Positions follow the in-game tactics screen as narrated for fm27/roles.py; position codes are the harness ones (configs and positions.csv). Summaries are our own one-liners, not game text.

GOALKEEPER.name: Goalkeeper
GOALKEEPER.summary: Standard keeper: stays in goal and distributes safely.

BALL_PLAYING_GOALKEEPER.name: Ball-Playing Goalkeeper
BALL_PLAYING_GOALKEEPER.summary: Joins the build-up, coming off the line to receive and pass.

NO_NONSENSE_GOALKEEPER.name: No-Nonsense Goalkeeper
NO_NONSENSE_GOALKEEPER.summary: Shot-stopper who gets rid of the ball with minimal risk.

ADVANCED_CENTRE_BACK.name: Advanced Centre-Back
ADVANCED_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Steps out of the back line into midfield when the team has the ball.

BALL_PLAYING_CENTRE_BACK.name: Ball-Playing Centre-Back
BALL_PLAYING_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Central defender who looks for progressive passes from the back.

NO_NONSENSE_CENTRE_BACK.name: No-Nonsense Centre-Back
NO_NONSENSE_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Stays ready to defend and keeps it simple on the ball.

WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.name: Wide Centre-Back
WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Outside centre-back of a back three; carries the ball and supports down the flank.

OVERLAPPING_CENTRE_BACK.name: Overlapping Centre-Back
OVERLAPPING_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Outside centre-back of a back three who overlaps the wide player.

FULL_BACK.name: Full-Back
FULL_BACK.summary: Defends the flank first and supports attacks with overlaps.

INSIDE_FULL_BACK.name: Inside Full-Back
INSIDE_FULL_BACK.summary: Tucks in beside the centre-backs to form a back three in possession.

WING_BACK.name: Wing-Back
WING_BACK.summary: Covers the whole flank and gives width in attack.

INSIDE_WING_BACK.name: Inside Wing-Back
INSIDE_WING_BACK.summary: Moves into central midfield in build-up, adding a passing option and cover against counters.

PLAYMAKING_WING_BACK.name: Playmaking Wing-Back
PLAYMAKING_WING_BACK.summary: Wide defender who gets on the ball to create; needs high technique.

ADVANCED_WING_BACK.name: Advanced Wing-Back
ADVANCED_WING_BACK.summary: Plays as high and wide as possible, almost a winger.

DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.name: Defensive Midfielder
DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Shields the defence and recycles possession.

HALF_BACK.name: Half Back
HALF_BACK.summary: Drops between the centre-backs during build-up as an extra defender.

DEEP_LYING_PLAYMAKER.name: Deep-Lying Playmaker
DEEP_LYING_PLAYMAKER.summary: Dictates play from in front of the defence with progressive passes.

BOX_TO_BOX_MIDFIELDER.name: Box-To-Box Midfielder
BOX_TO_BOX_MIDFIELDER.summary: Covers ground between both boxes, helping in attack and defence.

BOX_TO_BOX_PLAYMAKER.name: Box-To-Box Playmaker
BOX_TO_BOX_PLAYMAKER.summary: Box-to-box runner who is also a main passing hub.

MIDFIELD_PLAYMAKER.name: Midfield Playmaker
MIDFIELD_PLAYMAKER.summary: Creative link between defence and attack.

WIDE_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.name: Wide Central Midfielder
WIDE_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.summary: Side midfielder of a pair or three who drifts wide to support.

CHANNEL_MIDFIELDER.name: Channel Midfielder
CHANNEL_MIDFIELDER.summary: Runs into the channels and wide areas to link with the wide attackers.

ADVANCED_PLAYMAKER.name: Advanced Playmaker
ADVANCED_PLAYMAKER.summary: Finds pockets between the lines to create chances.

ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.name: Attacking Midfielder
ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.summary: Links midfield and attack, arriving to shoot or set up chances.

FREE_ROLE.name: Free Role
FREE_ROLE.summary: Roams wherever space appears to create.

SECOND_STRIKER.name: Second Striker
SECOND_STRIKER.summary: Attacking midfielder who plays as one of the main goal threats.

WIDE_MIDFIELDER.name: Wide Midfielder
WIDE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Balanced wide player: protects the flank and supports counters.

WINGER.name: Winger
WINGER.summary: Stays wide to stretch the defence and deliver crosses.

INSIDE_WINGER.name: Inside Winger
INSIDE_WINGER.summary: Drifts into the half-space to free the flank for overlaps.

PLAYMAKING_WINGER.name: Playmaking Winger
PLAYMAKING_WINGER.summary: Starts wide, then drifts inside as the team's main creator.

INSIDE_FORWARD.name: Inside Forward
INSIDE_FORWARD.summary: Cuts inside from the flank to shoot or combine centrally.

WIDE_FORWARD.name: Wide Forward
WIDE_FORWARD.summary: Wide attacker who stretches the back line and attacks the box.

CHANNEL_FORWARD.name: Channel Forward
CHANNEL_FORWARD.summary: High-energy striker who keeps running into the channels.

DEEP_LYING_FORWARD.name: Deep-Lying Forward
DEEP_LYING_FORWARD.summary: Drops off the line to link play and bring others in.

FALSE_NINE.name: False Nine
FALSE_NINE.summary: Drops between the lines like a playmaker, emptying the centre.

POACHER.name: Poacher
POACHER.summary: Lives on the last defender's shoulder to run in behind and finish.

TARGET_FORWARD.name: Target Forward
TARGET_FORWARD.summary: Physical focal point for long balls and crosses.

GOALKEEPER.name: Goalkeeper
GOALKEEPER.summary: Default keeper positioning without the ball.

SWEEPER_KEEPER.name: Sweeper Keeper
SWEEPER_KEEPER.summary: Starts high and sweeps up behind the defensive line.

CENTRE_BACK.name: Centre-Back
CENTRE_BACK.summary: Default central defending, between stepping out and covering.

COVERING_CENTRE_BACK.name: Covering Centre-Back
COVERING_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Drops off to cover the space behind the line.

STOPPING_CENTRE_BACK.name: Stopping Centre-Back
STOPPING_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Steps out aggressively to stop attackers receiving.

WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.name: Wide Centre-Back
WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Default defending for the outside centre-back of a back three.

COVERING_WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.name: Covering Wide Centre-Back
COVERING_WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Outside centre-back who covers space in the channel.

STOPPING_WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.name: Stopping Wide Centre-Back
STOPPING_WIDE_CENTRE_BACK.summary: Outside centre-back who steps out to engage in the channel.

HOLDING_FULL_BACK.name: Holding Full-Back
HOLDING_FULL_BACK.summary: Stays with the back line instead of jumping out.

PRESSING_FULL_BACK.name: Pressing Full-Back
PRESSING_FULL_BACK.summary: Pushes up to press the opposition wide player.

HOLDING_WING_BACK.name: Holding Wing-Back
HOLDING_WING_BACK.summary: Drops into the back line to defend.

PRESSING_WING_BACK.name: Pressing Wing-Back
PRESSING_WING_BACK.summary: Pushes up to press the opposition wide player.

DROPPING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.name: Dropping Defensive Midfielder
DROPPING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Drops into the back line as an extra defender.

PRESSING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.name: Pressing Defensive Midfielder
PRESSING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Steps out to press the ball.

SCREENING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.name: Screening Defensive Midfielder
SCREENING_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Holds in front of the defence to block passing lanes.

WIDE_COVER_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.name: Wide Covering Defensive Midfielder
WIDE_COVER_DEFENSIVE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Shifts across to help defend the flanks.

PRESSING_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.name: Pressing Central Midfielder
PRESSING_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.summary: Jumps out to press opposition midfielders.

SCREENING_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.name: Screening Central Midfielder
SCREENING_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.summary: Holds position to block passes through the middle.

WIDE_COVER_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.name: Wide Covering Central Midfielder
WIDE_COVER_CENTRAL_MIDFIELDER.summary: Shifts wide to help the flank.

WIDE_OUTLET_WIDE_MIDFIELDER.name: Wide Outlet Wide Midfielder
WIDE_OUTLET_WIDE_MIDFIELDER.summary: Stays high and wide as a counter-attack outlet.

ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.name: Attacking Midfielder
ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.summary: Default: screens the opposition's midfield pivot.

CENTRAL_OUTLET_ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.name: Central Outlet Attacking Midfielder
CENTRAL_OUTLET_ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.summary: Stays central and high as a counter-attack outlet.

SPLITTING_OUTLET_ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.name: Splitting Outlet Attacking Midfielder
SPLITTING_OUTLET_ATTACKING_MIDFIELDER.summary: Waits between centre-back and full-back to break on the counter.

TRACKING_WINGER.name: Tracking Winger
TRACKING_WINGER.summary: Tracks back with the opposition full-back.

WIDE_OUTLET_WINGER.name: Wide Outlet Winger
WIDE_OUTLET_WINGER.summary: Holds a high, wide position for the counter instead of tracking back.

INSIDE_OUTLET_WINGER.name: Inside Outlet Winger
INSIDE_OUTLET_WINGER.summary: Holds a high position in the half-space for the counter.

TRACKING_CENTRE_FORWARD.name: Tracking Centre Forward
TRACKING_CENTRE_FORWARD.summary: Drops back to follow an opposition midfielder.

CENTRAL_OUTLET_CENTRE_FORWARD.name: Central Outlet Centre Forward
CENTRAL_OUTLET_CENTRE_FORWARD.summary: Stays central and high as a counter-attack outlet.

SPLITTING_OUTLET_CENTRE_FORWARD.name: Splitting Outlet Centre Forward
SPLITTING_OUTLET_CENTRE_FORWARD.summary: Waits between centre-back and full-back to break on the counter.
